subject.title: Sub-agent timeout recovery creates duplicate API posts (idempotency gap)

question: Should OpenClaw add a core durable logical-action idempotency and replay contract for sub-agent/tool side effects beyond existing exact-key message/gateway dedupe?
rationale: The remaining gap spans agent, gateway, and tool semantics; the wrong key boundary can either duplicate side effects or suppress legitimate repeated actions.

options.title: Design a narrow core contract
options.body: Define logical action identity, payload digest, expiry, replay result, and audit behavior before implementing a core/gateway change.

options.title: Keep exact-key core semantics
options.body: Treat current gateway and message-tool idempotency as the supported core contract and leave external API idempotency to workflows/plugins.

options.title: Route to ClawHub guidance
options.body: Keep core unchanged and point unattended multi-agent operators to a ClawHub skill or service-specific idempotency patterns.

recommendation.title: Design a narrow core contract
recommendation.body: Define logical action identity, payload digest, expiry, replay result, and audit behavior before implementing a core/gateway change.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans multiple current agent/gateway files where steipete is the strongest current history and routing signal from this checkout.
